segments.contextBefore: The following code demonstrates creating an edge loop to implement an impenetrable boundary that extends from edge to edge in the scene.
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
func createSceneContents() {
    self.backgroundColor = .black
    self.scaleMode = .aspectFit
    self.physicsBody = SKPhysicsBody(edgeLoopFrom: self.frame)
}
```
